_metadata.description: Reference-based AI creation and refinement. First-release contract; completion follows requirement-linked behavior and retained protocol evidence.

requirements.title: The creation job shall preserve its source-to-candidate stages.
requirements.description: When creation is requested, the system shall record identity/reference gathering, measured facts, source selection, import/adaptation/original construction, comparison, refinement and candidate packaging as resumable stages.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-CREATION-PIPELINE protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

requirements.title: The creation job shall refine against fixed evidence.
requirements.description: The creation workflow shall lock verified dimensions, calibrate reference cameras, compare neutral geometry and held-out views, then refine materials/light with per-iteration hypotheses and uncertainty.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED. Follow the named DS-CREATION-REFERENCE-LOOP protocol, including its counterexample, and retain actual inputs, commands, receipts, results and reviewer verdict. The protocol is a verification plan, not passing evidence.

metadata.planned_automation: Reference instrument tests and real held-out-view refinement review.

requirements.title: The creation job shall keep autonomous work inside its grant.
requirements.description: The creation orchestrator shall search/import/build/refine within the disclosed total time, compute, spend, workspace and child-agent envelope and pause for an explicit revised choice before expanding it.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED as a complete requirement. Partial implementation evidence: durable local-only parent sessions pin scope and cap two calls at 4096 output tokens each, with atomic admission, cancel/claim race handling, SQLite resume, and explicit linked-session confirmation for scope expansion. The fresh served-build parent-to-candidate path is still pending; retain inputs, receipts, counterexample, and reviewer verdict before changing status. See docs/internal/goal/evidence/E5/current-creation-session-build.md.

requirements.title: The execution adapter shall isolate untrusted model tooling.
requirements.description: Before executing imported/generated scripts, the owner adapter shall enforce bounded resources, allowed filesystem/network policy and disabled automatic script execution without exposing credentials or download sessions.

validation.notes: NOT EXECUTED as a complete requirement. Partial evidence covers only the fixed finite-recipe Go compiler through protected workspace-sandbox (network and out-of-workspace writes denied; bounded process/time/virtual-address-space profile). This does not establish OS-read confinement or arbitrary-code/archive isolation. Arbitrary scripts and Blender execution are unsupported and refused. Follow the full named protocol and retain its counterexample and reviewer verdict before changing status. See docs/internal/goal/evidence/E5/current-creation-session-build.md.

metadata.planned_automation: Sandbox/argv/archive adversarial tests and containment qualification.

requirements.title: The system shall separate candidate readiness from release.
requirements.description: When a creation ends, the system shall expose comparisons, unresolved mismatches and retained candidates and require the established review/release authority before reusable-library publication.
